title: Na-eto eto n'enweghị nsogbu: zụta ọnụ, nyefee njikwa, mee atụmatụ maka ihe egwu

say: Na-eto eto n'enweghị nsogbu: zụta ọnụ, were njikwa nyefe ma mee atụmatụ maka ihe egwu.
Nke a bụ vidiyo maka modul atọ nke Chain Supply Chain na Raw Materials Sourcing: na-eto ụdọ ọkọnọ na-agbanwe agbanwe.
oyi akwa ọ bụla n'etiti gị na isi mmalite na-agbakwunye oke na igbu oge. Ịzụta nso nwere ike belata ọnụ ahịa gị, mana ọ chọrọ iwu ka ukwuu, ego buru ibu na mbụ, yana ihe egwu dị n'akụkụ gị.

say: Ego otu chọrọ iwu doro anya. Dee nkwekọrịta dị nkenke na ụdịdị ahụ, ọnụọgụ onye otu ọ bụla, otu esi ekere òkè, yana onye ji ego ahụ.

Chịkọta ego niile n'otu akaụntụ tupu ịkwụ ụgwọ, ma kesaa nnata n'ime otu ahụ. Tulee òkè nke ọ bụla n'ihu ndị otu ma ọ bụ na vidiyo, ma kwenye n'ihu ihe ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na ihe ahụ adaghị nkọwapụta ahụ.

say: Ụfọdụ ihe dị naanị ná mba ọzọ. Azụmahịa mba ụwa na-eji Incoterms kwupụta onye na-akwụ ụgwọ yana mgbe ihe egwu gafere. Na-ekwenyekarị okwu na ebe akpọrọ aha na ederede. N'okpuru CIF, onye na-ere ahịa na-akwụ ụgwọ ibu, mana ihe ize ndụ ka na-agafe gị mgbe ị na-ebu.

panel.heading: Ihe egwu atọ mgbe ị na-ebubata

cards.d: Kwekọrịta na Incoterm na ebe akpọrọ aha na ederede. N'okpuru CIF, ihe ize ndụ na-enyefe gị na nbudata.
Naịra 10% adịghị ike tụgharịrị ngwa ahịa 3,000,000 naịra 3,300,000.
Lelee iwu SON na NAFDAC, jiri onye na-ahụ maka kọstọm nwere ikike, nyochaa onye na-ebubata ya, malite na nlele.

say: Enwerekwa ihe ize ndụ mgbanwe mgbanwe. Iji maa atụ, ngwa ahịa na-efu 3,000,000 naịra na-efu 3,300,000 ma ọ bụrụ na naira dara 10% tupu ịkwụ ụgwọ. Wulite oke maka nke a.
